Here are a few Google search rewrites, tailored to finding high-margin digital product ideas, keeping context in mind:

*   **"high profit margin digital products ideas"** - Simple, direct, and clear.
*   **"best online business ideas high profit margins"** -  Broadens the search to include online businesses that primarily sell digital products.
*   **"digital product ideas minimal overhead"** - Focuses on the low-cost aspect that contributes to high margins.
*   **"lucrative digital products to sell online"** - Uses a different synonym for profit, widening the net.
*   **"(profitable evergreen digital products) - (subscriptions)"** -This is important, focusing on sustainable products.
*   **"what are the most profitable digital niche products"** - Suggests the search for a niche idea, more tailored than "products"
*   **"low cost high margin digital products"** - Specifies the combination of attributes desired.

I recommend starting with the first two and then exploring the others if you need more variety or a different angle. The last searches are helpful to get you to go the extra "niche" mile.
